section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
title: Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna Tests

content.description: Flowchart for Test 3 showing troubleshooting steps for antenna plug, radio functionality, and antenna booster checks. The flowchart begins with checking antenna plug security, branches through various decision points including plug reinsertion, radio-only operation, and antenna booster presence, leading to outcomes such as proper insertion, tape player replacement, proceeding to Test 4, or proceeding to Test 5.
labels: Check that antenna plug is secure in radio.

content.description: Flowchart for Test 4 showing troubleshooting steps for booster power and radio connector checks. The flowchart begins with checking booster power to connectors behind radio, branches through connector reinsertion and power verification, leading to outcomes such as connector inspection, proceeding to Test 5, or wire harness inspection and repair.
labels: Check that there is booster power to connectors behind radio.
Is there power to radio connector?

content.description: Flowchart for Test 5 showing troubleshooting steps for antenna replacement testing. The flowchart begins with temporarily installing another antenna, and based on results either proceeds to inspect and replace antenna components or replace the radio.
labels: Inspect antenna, antenna cable and booster, and replace as necessary.
